meta.title: MC compiler
meta.description: Compile .mc scripts and read their diagnostics in the sidebar.
meta.detail: Lists the .mc scripts of a ProgrammableFurnace checkout, compiles them with the mod's own analyzer through a local JDK, and shows each file's state (executable, dependency, failed, blank) with error codes and positions. The same compiler is exposed to the agent as the mc_compile tool.
